name: io.github.Zierold-Ventures/dotiphant
title: Dotiphant
description: Search and read your Telegram chats from a local, read-only archive on your own computer.

environmentVariables.name: DOTIPHANT_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder with the archive and settings. Defaults to the platform data folder.

environmentVariables.name: DOTIPHANT_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Where secrets are stored: keyring (the system keyring, the default) or file (files under DOTIPHANT_HOME, readable only by you).
